entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1296713990316692096: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 73555: distance 69.061 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.01), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 69.061 +/- 0.691 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 13.8780 +/- 0.1310 mas (same row, RUWE 3.44), 105.9 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -40.708, -30.168 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 1296713990316692096 (quality A), from 2015A&A...574A..50J; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 18.673 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 73555: radius 18.673 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 198.63 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.051) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5018 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 73555: effective temperature 5018 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.077).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 709: HR 5602; VizieR III/202, cross-checked against Gaia DR3 XP spectrum, source 1296713990316692096 (45 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffeacc. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 133208 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 5602 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 5602 is not among its 60 stars; burnashev: BS 5602 is not in part2; kharitonov: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,018 K and log g 2.8 (u1 0.623, u2 0.151): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.8 from 2025A&A...698A..93J; the 17 published values span log g 2.35 to 3.06, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness.
